title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:

Location: Chelmsford / Leigh-on-Sea
Hours: Monday-Friday 9:00am-5:30pm

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a successful family-run practice that combines exceptional client service with a supportive team culture. If you have at least two years' experience in residential property and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, this could be the perfect next step in your career.

About the Firm

This well-established, family-run law firm has built an excellent reputation for providing outstanding legal services while maintaining a personal, approachable way of working. With ambitious growth plans and a strong commercial outlook, the firm continues to expand while staying true to its core values of teamwork, professionalism and exceptional client care.

Employees are encouraged to develop their skills, contribute ideas and build long-term careers within the business. The firm offers a welcoming and collaborative working environment where everyone's contribution is valued.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll play an important role within the Residential Property department, providing essential support to an experienced team of conveyancing professionals. Working on a varied caseload, you'll help ensure property transactions progress efficiently from instruction through to completion while delivering a first-class experience for clients.

This role is ideal for someone with at least two years' experience in residential conveyancing who is highly organised, proactive and enjoys building strong relationships with clients and colleagues alike.

You'll work closely with fee earners, developers, mortgage brokers and third parties, helping to keep matters moving and ensuring deadlines are consistently met.

Key Responsibilities

Your day-to-day duties will include:
- Acting as the first point of contact for clients, developers, brokers and other parties involved in residential property transactions.
- Processing new client onboarding documentation.
- Carrying out identity verification and anti-money laundering checks.
- Reviewing proof of funds and source of funds documentation.
- Progressing new instructions through the early stages of transactions.
- Supporting new build conveyancing matters.
- Working within InfoTrack (full training provided where required).
- Ordering and reviewing Local Authority, Chancel and other property searches.
- Preparing completion statements.
- Managing Lifetime ISA (LISA) and Help to Buy ISA withdrawals.
- Using NHBC warranty portals where required.
- Preparing Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) forms.
- Preparing Land Registry documentation.
- Assisting with exchange and completion processes.
- Providing administrative support across the conveyancing team.
- Supporting multiple fee earners with day-to-day case progression.
- Maintaining accurate case records and files.
- Working collaboratively to achieve team targets and key performance indicators.

About You

The successful candidate will be an enthusiastic and motivated Conveyancing Paralegal who enjoys working as part of a supportive team and takes pride in delivering excellent client service.

You'll ideally have:
- A minimum of two years' experience in a Residential Property Paralegal or Conveyancing Assistant role.
- Solid understanding of the residential conveyancing process.
- Experience supporting fee earners with a busy caseload.
- Knowledge of AML requirements and client onboarding.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to prioritise a varied workload and meet deadlines.
- A proactive approach with excellent problem-solving skills.
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties by telephone and email.
- A professional, friendly and approachable manner.
- Strong IT skills and confidence learning new systems.
- Previous case management software experience (desirable but not essential).
- A genuine commitment to providing outstanding client care.
- The ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Why Join?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing law firm that genuinely invests in its people. You'll work alongside experienced professionals who are committed to helping you develop your career while enjoying a supportive and positive workplace culture.

Whether you're looking to broaden your residential property knowledge, gain exposure to new build transactions or simply join a firm where your work is recognised and appreciated, this role offers excellent long-term prospects.

Benefits

The firm offers an attractive benefits package including:
- Ongoing professional training and development.
- Career progression opportunities.
- Medicash healthcare scheme.
- Health, dental and eyecare benefits.
- Team social events throughout the year.
- Discounted parking.
- 26 days' annual leave plus Bank Holidays.
- Annual leave loyalty scheme.
- Office closure between Christmas and New Year.
- Staff referral bonus scheme.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.

Apply Now

If you're an experienced Conveyancing Paralegal with at least two years' residential property experience and are looking to join a friendly, ambitious law firm where your contribution will be valued, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to take the next step in your conveyancing career.

title: Fitness to Practice Administrator
description:
Job Title: Fitness to Practice Administrator

Location: Chelmsford campus

Start Date: ASAP

Proposed End Date: 23rd December 2026

Hours: 37hrs per week

Rate of pay: 16.19ph

Job Purpose:

To coordinate and oversee the University's Fitness to Practise processes, ensuring cases are managed efficiently, consistently and in line with regulatory, professional and University requirements. The role provides specialist administrative support, manages complex casework, and drives process improvements to maintain a high-quality service.

Key Responsibilities:

Act as the principal administrator for Fitness to Practise processes, coordinating the end to end administration of cases and ensuring compliance with University regulations, professional standards and statutory requirements.

Maintain and oversee the central record of all Fitness to Practise concerns, ensuring information is accurately recorded, monitored and reported, and that appropriate audit trails are maintained.

Monitor case progression and proactively manage Fitness to Practise workflows, identifying key deadlines, escalating issues where appropriate, and ensuring cases are progressed in a timely manner.

Coordinate and administer Fitness to Practise panels and associated meetings, managing complex scheduling requirements and ensuring arrangements comply with procedural requirements.

Arrange and support initial review meetings and Fitness to Practise hearings, including the preparation of agendas, meeting documentation and Microsoft Teams arrangements.

Provide specialist administrative guidance to academic and professional services staff, students and practice partners on Fitness to Practise procedures and processes, referring complex matters as appropriate.

Communicate with students throughout the Fitness to Practise process, including requesting statements, providing procedural information and ensuring that required documentation is obtained within agreed timescales.

Coordinate meetings between students and the Professionalism Lead, ensuring relevant information is available to support effective discussion and decision making.

Collate, quality check and circulate Fitness to Practise documentation, ensuring panel members receive complete and accurate information within required timescales.

Support panel proceedings by preparing and distributing documentation, recording actions and ensuring outcomes are accurately documented and communicated.

Communicate panel outcomes, recommendations and associated actions to relevant stakeholders, including University staff, practice partners and external organisations, ensuring confidentiality and procedural compliance.

Prepare, distribute and maintain records of transcripts, summaries and formal correspondence arising from Fitness to Practise proceedings.

Liaise with practice partners and internal colleagues to identify, secure and coordinate panel membership, ensuring appropriate representation and adherence to panel requirements.

Produce and analyse management information relating to Fitness to Practise activity, identifying trends and providing reports to support operational planning and decision making.

Review and contribute to the development of administrative processes, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance efficiency, consistency and service delivery.

Requirements:

Experience relevant to the role

Previous experience of providing specialist knowledge

Experience of analysing and resolving problems through detailed manipulation and analysis of information

Experience of analysing data and writing reports

People Management

Excellent digital literacy and systems capability, with experience of evaluating and implementing digital solutions to improve processes, efficiency and service delivery.

Good understanding of the standards and regulations relating to relevant PSRBs

DESIRABLE:

Experience of low code/no code development (e.g. PowerAutomate)

How to apply: Please provide a CV and Cover letter confirming why you are suitable for the role.

title: Sales Account Executive

description:
Job Title: Sales Account Executive

Location: Chelmsford, Essex

Salary: £35,000 basic salary + uncapped monthly bonus (realistic OTE £40,000 - £50,000+)

Job type: Permanent, Full Time. Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm, with no weekend work.

The Plumbing Distribution Company Ltd (PDC) is a successful, family-run B2 B distribution business that has proudly served plumbing merchants since 2006.

We are built around gold-standard service, reliability, trust and continuous improvement. After 20 years of growth, we are entering an exciting new period of expansion.

We are now looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Sales Account Executive to join our team and play a key role in the next stage of PDC's development.

The Role:

This is a proactive B2 B sales position responsible for managing and developing an established customer portfolio while identifying new business opportunities.

You will build strong relationships with plumbing and builders' merchants, increase account performance, reactivate dormant customers and generate new business across the UK.

Working closely with Operations, Purchasing, Logistics and Management, you will become a trusted point of contact for your customers while contributing directly to company sales and gross profit targets.

We are looking for someone who is confident speaking with customers, commercially minded and motivated by measurable results, while maintaining PDC's high standards of service.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and develop an established portfolio of plumbing and builders' merchant customers.
- Achieve agreed sales, revenue and account growth targets.
- Handle inbound sales enquiries by telephone, email, WhatsApp and customer portal.
- Proactively contact existing, dormant and prospective customers to generate new business.
- Build relationships with key customer decisionmakers.
- Identify upselling, cross-selling and product promotion opportunities.
- Prepare quotations and follow up opportunities to maximise conversion.
- Manage the sales process from enquiry through to order completion.
- Identify and secure new merchant accounts across the UK.
- Reactivate dormant and develop underperforming customer accounts.
- Maintain regular customer contact through a structured monthly call programme.
- Follow up all quotations within 48 hours.
- Maintain accurate CRM records and sales activity.
- Monitor account performance, opportunities and pipeline development.
- Work with internal departments to resolve customer, stock, delivery and service issues.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be driven by consistent customer engagement, proactive account management and commercial performance.

You will be expected to maintain structured customer contact and achieve agreed activity and sales targets. Typical activity levels will include 50-70 customer conversations per day alongside ownership of a monthly account contact programme.

Performance will be measured through sales revenue, gross profit growth, account development, customer retention, new account acquisition and agreed activity targets.

About You:

To be successful, you will need:
- Previous experience in B2 B sales, account management, business development, internal sales or telesales.
- Experience managing and developing customer accounts.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Confidence engaging customers and influencing purchasing decisions.
- A professional telephone manner and excellent verbal communication.
- Commercial awareness and a results-focused approach.
- Strong organisational, planning and time-management skills.
- Experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
- A proactive, resilient and persistent approach to sales.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and work to targets.
- A practical, customer-focused approach to problem solving.

Experience within plumbing, heating, construction products, merchanting or distribution would be advantageous.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, consistently delivers on commitments and maintains high professional standards. Most importantly, you will share our commitment to outstanding customer service through product knowledge, responsiveness, reliability and a customer-first mindset.

What We Offer:
- Established customer portfolio to manage and develop.
- Clear and achievable sales targets.
- Structured training and ongoing professional development.
- In-house certifications and skills development opportunities.
- Supportive environment where ideas, accountability and continuous improvement are valued.
- Genuine long-term career progression opportunities.
- Monday-Friday working hours with no weekend work.
- Opportunity to join a growing family-run business.

Apply Today:

If you are an ambitious sales professional looking to develop customer relationships, win new business, increase account performance and earn through your results, we would love to hear from you.
